target_customer: Engineering organizations and CTOs at growth stage software companies
problem: Teams struggle to keep up with fast changing AI coding tools and to find their real delivery bottleneck. Mesmer first reported on engineering work and now ships fixes into customer codebases as pull requests.
business_model: B2B services plus software, monthly improvement cycle per customer with demo led sales
product_category: Engineering intelligence and agentic engineering services

founders.name: João de Paula
founders.background_notes: YC page: self taught engineer with 15 years of product leadership. Education not stated.

founders.name: Sergio Oliveira Bergmann
founders.background_notes: YC page cites 15 plus years of engineering leadership in fintech and digital banking, employers not named.

competitors.name: Jellyfish
competitors.what: Software engineering intelligence platform; added tracking of AI coding tools in June 2025

competitors.name: LinearB
competitors.what: Engineering metrics platform for delivery data, with a Cursor integration

technical_complexity.rationale: Needs analysis across code, tickets and chat tools plus agent generated pull requests. Mostly integration and agent engineering, with human engineers in the loop.

defensibility.rationale: Deep access to a customer's repos and tooling and founder owned accounts create some stickiness. Analytics vendors and AI coding tool makers can copy reporting features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Jellyfish and LinearB added AI coding tool integrations in 2025. No acquisition of Mesmer found as of 2026-11.

market_need_then: AI coding tools changed how engineering teams work in 2025, and the company says leaders lack visibility. Launch coverage claims 70M lines of code reviewed and 10 plus live customers (secondary source, unverified).

branding.domain_note: Uses mesmer.co. A different California company named Mesmer (mobile app testing, 15M Series A in 2019) also exists

identity.voice_and_tone: Launched as Cursor for CTOs; later positioned as an Agentic Factory with founder owned accounts

brand_strength.rationale: Launch positioning borrowed Cursor's brand and one trade piece covered the company, but name overlaps an older company and no community evidence found.

pivots.from: AI chief of staff giving CTOs weekly engineering reports (Cursor for CTOs, launched 2025-05)
pivots.to: Agentic factory that opens pull requests in customer codebases
pivots.why: RuntimeWire (2026-10-11) says the company is moving from engineering reports to pull requests because AI raises code volume; exact pivot date not stated

outcome_analysis: Mesmer is active. Repeat founders from Origin Financial launched in YC Spring 2025 as Cursor for CTOs, claimed fast early traction and later shifted from reporting to hands on engineering fixes. Backers per the YC page are YC, GFC and 468 Capital but no round size is confirmed. The risk is that analytics vendors and AI coding tool makers absorb the offering.
notes: Investors YC, GFC and 468 Capital appear on the YC page with no amounts or dates, so no round is recorded. A 500K pre-seed on nordic9 (Pioneer Fund, Rebel Fund, Kaya VC and others) is a single aggregator and unverified. Dealroom's 15M Series A belongs to a different, older company also called Mesmer (Intel Capital 2019) and was ignored. Berlin location comes from the directory. Education not found for any founder. LinearB source date is approximate.
